(207)༄༅/dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi mnan pa'i yig chung gcig shes kun grol bzhugs/khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs dang lhag pa'i lha/ /'chol ba'i khro rgya

tei:div.tei:p: (207)༄༅/ dbang chen rdo rje gro lod kyi mnan pa'i yig chung gcig shes kun grol bzhugs/

khyab bdag bla ma'i zhabs dang lhag pa'i lha// 'chol ba'i khro rgyal chen por gus btud nas// mnan pa'i las rim ri rab nag po yi// bcas bshams lag len 'chad 'dod gnang ba rtsol/ de yang man ngag snying gzer nag po las/ dmigs rten 'ben du bca' ba ni// dgra bgegs liṅga 'bri ba yin// snying gar rnam shes yig 'bru re// dpral bar ming bris kha la rus// steng 'og gnyis la gcod gzer gnyis// mtha' la 'phrog byed yi ge bzhi// yan lag bzhi la gcod byed bzhi// dpung pa gnyis la myos byed bri// 'di la gzugs can gzugs med do/ zhes gsungs pa'i dgongs don gyi zab gnad rnams gtso bor bris te man ngag gi brgyan pa'i dgra 'dri'i liṅga so sor bri ba yin te/ de yang dus tshod ni/ gyim shang zhag pa nag po las/ shog gu gro ga ro ras la/ khrag chen gtsan dug sbyar nas ni// phung gsum bra nye'i nyin zhag la// gsum pa stag gi dus tshod dus// nyi ma rtse shar srod tshun chod/ khams dang sbyar ba'i phung dus der// las byed 'brug gi nyi ma la// dgra bdud dur zhugs kun la 'gre/ zhes dang*/ drang srong sha lde ru rtse ba'i man ngag las/ nam langs yos la nyi shar 'brug /dus tshod bcu gnyis des 'gre'o// snga gro me la nyin gungs// phyi dro lcags la dgongs ka chu// nyi shar shing la sa sros shing*/ srod 'khor me la nam (208) gung sa// tho rangs lcags la skya rengs chu// 'di rnams zhib tu brtsi ba gnad/ ces dang*/ stag lo'i bdud skar mchu gre gnyis// yos bu'i dbo la 'brug sa ri// sbrul gyi dbyug gu lag sor te// rta sbrul lha mtshams gnyis po ste// lug gi chu smad gro bzhin dang*// sprel gyi mon gre mon gru gnyis// bya yi khrums stod khrums smad dang*// khyi yi nam gru dbyug gu ste// phag gi smin drug snar ma dang*// byi ba'i 'go lag glang nabs rgyal// de ni skar ma'i gyim shang ngo*/

zhes dang*/ gzhan yang lo zla zhag dus za bdun mthun bdud sogs zhib tu brtsi bgos kyang de tsam gyis mtha' bsdus nas/ mi 'dus rkyen bzhi shar rkyen bzhi// rten la mi khug gnad bzhi po// spangs nas tshad ldan bri bar bya/ zhes pa'i skyon bral zhig nges par gtso che/ thog mar rang gi kha lag gdong gsum dag par bkrus nas/ sgo gsum gyi nus pa rgyas/ de rjes lag par bsad khrag dang bsad thal byug sha chen nam rtsa ba gsum mur bzhin par bang kheb kha ras dang bcas lha'i nga rgyal la gnas pas kha blta phyogs/ dmigs bya'i bdud gcod dam/ lho nub/ lho/ sgra gcan sde brgyad sogs kyi thab phyogs dang*/ nyi ma'i 'char bzhud sogs rang grib mi 'go ba'i thabs sogs phyogs mthun rig pa'i mda' mo yang 'phen/ snag tsha'i rgyu yug sa'i khog drag gam/ rgya snag gtsang ma/ ro sol sogs la/ mchod rten rnying pa'i rmang zhabs phung shul/ ri mtho nyi 'char snga ba'i rmang sa sogs dang*/ phag nag gri mdze/ ra khrag bya sha zan/ gcan zan (209) gdug pa can gyi khrag btsan dug til nag ldong ros/ lan tshwa/ skye tshe/ zar khu/ mi rus sogs ci 'dzom bsres nas thod ngan nam/ gri lcags kyi kong bur sbyangs pas las rang bzhin gyis 'grub pa'i dgos pa yod/ spro na bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod kyi ting nge 'dzin sngags rgyas gzas po dngos su bkugs la snag tsha dang dbyer med ro gcig tu bstim la rus pa'am lcags kyi lde mig gis snag tsha mnye ba dang phye mar 'thag pa'i dmigs pa byed/ bris smyug mi bsad mda' smyug gam/ bya sha zan gyi sgro rtsas bri/ gter gzhung las/ khyad par pho rog shis pa yin/ zhes gsungs/ che chung tshad ni/ rab la mda' gang ngam/ 'bring thar gzas po'i khru gang ngam mtho gang bya/ mi 'byams gnad la grong yul pha ma dang*/ bu tsha'i ming sogs shar yig bri bar gsungs/ ma bub ma zha ma long ma 'gyel gnad/ sri can la liṅga spyi khog 'dra ba la/

khyad par dgra ling rnams su sri ming snying gar bri/ mgo bo bsgyur dgos pas/ pho sri la g.yag dkar/ spyang ki'ang gsungs/ mo sri la khyi/ rgan sril wa/ dur sri sre mong*/ dar sri spyang ki dur sri wa/ dam sri phag spyi'i phung sri rnga mong*/ rgyal sri seṅge/ blon sri ri bong*/ dmangs sri dre'u/ dgra sri spyang ki mtshan sri sha ba/ gzhan yang mtshon khral bsdus nas de tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du brtsegs/ mnan dus su rtse mo thur la bstan nas mnan chas steng du btsug de'i steng du mchod rten bzhengs la sngags 'chang rnal 'byor byin rlabs dang ldan pas rab gnas (210) byas na/ mtshon dang 'khrug pa mtha' dmag sogs zhi bar gsungs pas/ mchod rten ma grub kyang mtshon sri'i rigs la de bzhin bstan 'gror dmigs nas bya thub na legs/ god sri ra/ g.ya' sri 'phar ba/ nye sri sdig pa/ byas sri rta'am rkyen gang yin/ gdon sri'i rigs la/ btsan sri dmar po 'ug mgo rgyal sri dkar po bya pho/ klu sri sngon po sbrul/ bdud sri nag po khyung*/ lo sri lo bdud/ zla sri klu bdud kyi mgo can/ dus sri dus der dmod pa sogs so/ dpral bar e trig nan/ mig gnyis la long/ rna ba gnyis la 'on/ sna la thibs/ kha nang du bdud pho long*/ mgrin par brjed/ dpung pa g.yas g.yon la dzaḥhūm̐/ pus mo g.yas g.yon la bam̐ hoḥ nywa ldir bzhir mā ra ya rbad ces 'bru bzhi'i 'og tu zhwa re re/ gsang bar phaṭaḥ rkang mthil gnyis su yam̐ re re/ snying ga'i sa bon la dzaḥkha sprod/ steng du eḥ g.yon du hur/ 'og tu thuṃḥ g.yas su dzaḥ de rgyab liṅga'i mgrin pa'i phyogs nas yig mgo phyir la bstan te/ bla 'gugs sngags bri/ brla g.yas g.yon du dar sri gdug pa can gyi bla srog shakti thun dzaḥ zhes pa'i yig mgo pus mo nas brtsams te bri/ ling ga'i phyi rol du mgo bo nas bzung sngags mgo phyir bstan du/ gzhung gi mnan sngags dang dmod byang bri/

de rgyab dzaḥkhram nyer gcig gi bskor re/ dgra bo'i snying ga'i sa bon la yig rigs mi 'dra mang du byung*/ lnga pa chen po'i phyag bzhes la nri 'di bzhin dang*/ dbur smyon chos kyi grags pas gshin (211) rje lcags sdig gi lung khungs su nṛ 'di bzhin 'dren/ gzhan dag nṛ 'di bzhin bzhed cing don du 'gro ba mi'i sa bon nyon mongs dug gsum gyi ngo bo snying dbus rus sbal gyi nang du yi ge'i rnam par gnas pa/ rten 'brel lugs 'byung du dug gsum rang rgyud la shar ba'i 'dod chags bya/ zhe sdang sbrul/ gti mug phag ste gsum po'i gzugs kyis mtshon byed dpe'i dbyibs su grub/ spro na dgra ling gi brla g.yas par sha ba'i gzugs brnyan nam/ sha ba zhes pa'i ming bris pa'i mthar/ dgra bo'i bla 'khyams sha bar brdzu ba dzaḥdzaḥ zhes bskor te bri/ de bzhin du rkyang la ghaḥ rta la dhaḥ g.yag la shuḥ bong bu la triḥ glang la muḥste bla rtags che ba drug gi srog dang*/ byi ba la huḥ phagapa la saḥ gna' bar laḥ lug la seḥ ra la dzaḥ gla ba la bhaḥste chung ba drug gi srog mthar dgra bo'i bla 'khyams 'di dang 'di ru brdzu ba dzaḥdzaḥ zhes snga ma bzhin du bri/ brla g.yon par bla len 'phar ba spyang ki dom dred khra glag sogs bla gshed drug gi khog par dgra bo glang lug khyi 'brug bzhi'i bla mo yin pas/ sha ra bha ste mā ra ya rbadaḥ ces rta'i gshed sngags/ sa la pra ghe la ti rbadaḥ ces sbrul gyi gshed sngags des 'gres bar stag yos lo pa'i bla de'i srog gi ma yin pas byi phag gnyis kyi gshed sngags/ sa dhi tsa ya du bhi tri rbadaḥ ces byi ba dang*/ bo se lu sha su ta rbadaḥ ces phag rta sbrul lo par/ a bhi ta ra me bhi rbadaḥ ces stag dang*/ sha sa ka ra na ra rbadaḥ ces yos/ bya sprel lo so sor/ a dabta ghri ta rbadaḥ ces glang dang*/ (212) par sha bhu ti sa phag rbadaḥ ces lug dang*/ bu na sa pu ra tra rbadaḥ

ces khyi/ sa ta ga te li du rbadaḥ ces 'brug de yang dper na glang lo pa yin na rta sbrul gang rung rais chog ste gnyis ka 'bri mi dgos pa sogs gzhan la'ang shes par bya'o/ bla bdud gzugs la dbab pa ni// byad ma'i bla dwags bri ba yin/ zhes gsungs pa'i zab gnad thun mong ma yin pa pa'am/ yang na yi ge tsha la/ troṃḥ triḥ shaṃḥ dzaḥ waṃḥ shaḥ gha ཿ dzaḥ traṃḥ thuḥ dzaḥ sogs mig mgo lta phyogs phol phyi/ mo ldog nas 'khor mar bri/ yang na/ triḥ troṃḥ shamaḥ bhaḥ sha ཿdzaḥ thuṃḥ yang na bla chen drug gi ming mthar bla khug dzaḥ yang na/ gnod byed dgra bo'i bla gang du brdzus kyang khug dzaḥ ces brla yi rtsa ba nas phred la bri/ dpral bar rus shes na de ka'i mthar khug dzaḥ ma shes na thams cad rus chen sde lngar 'du bas/ ji 'u kung keg shangs khug dzaḥ mgo bor dgra mgo thog tu babs pa thams cad st+waṃ bha ya nanaḥ gzhan gong dang 'dra/ liṅga ming gzugs pho mo gang 'os kyi rtags can rid cing mya ngan gyis gdung ba'i tshul/ mig shi mig kha gdangs shing yan lag bzhi lcags sgrog gis bsdam pa/ mtshan nyid tshang ba'i liṅga de nyid lhag chad bris bsubs spangs te dag par bri/ gal lte bris bsubs byed dgos na stag gi sder mos brad/ dmigs bya legs par tshar ba dang*/ phyi nang bye ma gsher ldan gyis phur/ zan gtsang mas dril phyis bya/ tshon gtong na/ kha dog 'byung ba gshed du bsdeb/ ces pas dmigs bya'i srog khams dang bstun/ (213) thums 'khor lo'i gshed du rdeb dgos pa sogs phra zhib kyi lag len mthong rgyun bzhin bya'o// skabs 'dir ling khrus bya ba ni/ rang gi mdun du yo byad rnams 'du byas la/ dang po rang grib sbyong ba ni/ rang gi spyi mgrin snying gar pad zla'i steng*// rdor sems dkar dmar mthing gsum 'od du 'bar// rdo rje dril 'dzin rin chen rus pas brgyan// dar zab longs spyod rdzogs sku'i cha lugs 'dzin// thugs dkar zla steng hūm̐ mthar yig brgyas bskor// de las 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas// sgo gsum nyes tshogs thams cad sangs kyis dag

/slar yang 'od 'phros 'phags pa thams cad mchod// tshur 'dus bdag gi dam tshig nyams chags dang*// byad phur ngag mnan gtad khram phra man gyi// nus mthu nyes tshogs ma lus rab byang nas// rang lus dwangs shel dri med lta bur gyur/ yig ge brgya pa bzlas rjes/ mgon po bdag ni sdig sgrib ma lus pa: dag par thugs rje bskul ba'i gdung shugs kyis: gnas gsum lha rnams 'od du zhu ba yis: dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu sa ma dhi: zhes brjod/ liṅga la srid pa'i bye ma'am zhing sa gtsang ma 'thor zhing*/ laṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe swa hā/ zhes dang*/ chu mig lkugs pa'am phyug rgyugs kyi chu ro skra'i chun pos 'thor zhing*/ baṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe swa hā/ de bzhin du lha dbye'i sgro gnyis kyis g.yab cing*/ yaṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe swa hā/ bra zhing gi mes bskor zhing*/ raṃ ho shuddhe shuddhe swa hā/ zhes pa la dri ma thim/ chus bkru/ rlung gis gtor/ mes bsreg pa'i dmigs pa bya zhing bar snang la g.yab cing*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag yon mchod kyi (214)lus kyi dri mas ma gos so/ ngag gi dri mas ma gos so/ yid kyi dri mas ma gos so/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri mas ma gos so/ e ho raṃ/ i na raṃ/ bi na raṃ/ shaddhe shaddhe ā āḥ zhes a rkyang nyer gcig dbugs thengs gcig la 'dren zhing gdod ma'i stong chen gyi ngang du kun rdzob kyi dri ma thams cad ye dag yongs grol du sbyangs la dar cig mnyam par bzhag zangs gzhong chu gtsang gis bkang ba mdun du bzhag la/ bdag nyid rdo rje gro lod gsal ba yi// mdun du bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin nyal 'gro'i dbus// paṃ las padma a las zla ba'i steng*// baṃ las chu yi lha mo sku mdog dkar// phyag g.yas gachog sbyin g.yon pas padma dmar// zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung rin chen brgyan// thugs las 'od 'phros rang 'dra'i ye shes drangs// dza hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥganyis su med par gyur// de yi phyag g.yas mchog sbyin baṃ ser las// bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs liṅga bshal ba yis// rnal 'byor bdag cag kha rlangs dri ma rdul// gzas po'i kha rje bsod nams tshe dpal 'byor/

ma lus chu yi nang du sib kyis thim/ hūm̐ ma ma ka bya ye hūm̐/ 'chang ba po la hūm̐ ma ma ki bya ye swa hā/ zhes liṅga bkrus/ slar yang chu yi lha mo 'od du zhu/ chu dang dbyer med bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ rang gis hub gcig 'thung bas tshe bsod bkrag mdangs rgyas par bsam/ chu lhag gnas khang phyi nang khyab par gtor bas (215)bkra shis byin chags/ 'bag btsog thams cad rang bzhin gyis dag par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ byug rdzas ni/ khrag sna gang 'dzom khyad par gri mdze'i khrag dug sna'i rtsi tshogs/ thang khroṃ dkar nag btsan dug phung sa sogs gdug pa'i sa sna gang 'dzom/ lha khang rnying pa/ ri nyil/ mchod rten zhig ral sogs kyi sa sna dang*/ dmigs bya de'i dri ma drug sogs zag rdzas/ keg sri sogs bgegs rigs la 'dre tshugs kyi sa dang*/ gang gnod de'i sa rdo chu shing bsad khrag dug sna sogs/ byug rdzas rnams khu ba 'byin pa'i phyir mer bsros nas rlangs thon tsam byed nas byug bzlog bsad kyi dkyil 'khor ni// phung gsum sa la ba byung lnga'i// dkyil 'khor stegs bu mda' gang ba// bdud rtsi khrag dang ldan pas byug /ces dang*/ rdo rje 'khor lo'i bar dag tu// ming rus ldan pa'i liṅga bcu// dpal gtor 'og tu gcig kyang bkod/ ces pa'i dkyil 'khor ma traṃ gyi khog par 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi mu khyud can/ lte ba chos 'byung rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dbus su lcags snod sogs kyi brub khung mtshan nyid tshang ba'i nang du bcug rtsibs rtse rnams su ming rus ldan pa'i zan gyi nya bo bcu dang*/ mthar rtsang dang zor rdzas sogs 'god/ 'jug pa bde phyir phung sa sogs drag po'i sa sna dang phye ma la byas pa'i maṇḍal mda' gang gru bzhi ro sol dang thal chen gyis nag por byas pa'i dbus su brub khung*/ phyed tsam nub par 'jug pa'am/ yang na lcags slang bug med pa bye mas bkang pa'i dbus su brub khung*/

ji ltar 'tshams pa blang la/ gri (216) khrag dug khrag dur thal sogs kyis sbags pa'i mthar skyer rtsang stod smad khrag dang dbus ro sol gyis nag por byug rtse mor sha yis brgyan pa nyer gcig srin mo 'gros sam 'tshub ma ris su btsugs la 'gugs byed kyi pho nyar mnga' gsol/ de nas liṅga rnams mang po yod na gartsigs/ 'khor ling yod tshe 'og tu bcug gzhug tshul ni/ ji skad du/ liṅga gshed bltab nṛ yig mthong*/ zhes pas mtha' nas rim par bsdus pa'i mtshon ltab bam ro sgong du grags pas snying ga'i sa bon mthong ba'am/ yang na sked rgyab tu bcag pa'i g.yas g.yon gshams sogs zur lteb zur gsum bzos nas sa bon mthong ba shi skra dang byad thag gis cung zad dkris nas zhug bcug de'i steng du mañdzi'am srid pa lugs 'byung drag po'i shing gi e khram steng mthong bar gong non gyi gtor ma bzhugs su gsol/ e khram re nag gam dar nag gi dkris la nyi zla'i zer/ mar me'i 'od/ bdud rtsi'i zegs ma sogs mi 'jug par byed/ 'bri khung chos kyi grags pas liṅga la bdud rtsi 'thor ba dmer 'gro gsungs/ gshin rje yang bzlog gi khrid rim du dgug gzhug gi gong du sman mi bran pa gnad zab ces bshad/ gang zag gzhan dag la bdud rtsi ni dam ldan la sman dang dam nyams la dug tu 'gyur ba'i skyon med par 'chad kyang*/ slob dpon chen po nas liṅga la sman raka bdud rtsi mi 'thor ba gal che gsungs/ nye logs ci bde bar g.yag rgod kyi rwar thun rdzas ni/ rke shangs yungs te 'bru gsum/ lcags zangs rdo ste phye ma gsum/ sbang bra ram

(217) gsum ngan gsum/ phung gsum dgu gsum sa sna dang phye ma/ mdze dam rabs chad khra spyang gri khrag sogs khrag sna/ btsan dug sogs dug sna'i rigs te sna gsum rnams kyis bkang ba'i kha dug shog khrol tshags can gyis bkag mtha' bskor du mnan snod ni/ rab mnol thod gri thod rabs chad kyi thod pa/ tha ma spyang dang ra khyi phag pa'i thod pa/ zhes spyir btang dang*/ sri can la mnan thod bye brag pa/ de dag grad brdar legs par byas pa'i 'gram pa g.yas la/ skyes pa pho'i pho sri langs pa nan chings brub: 'gram pa g.yon la/ bud med kyi mo sri langs pa nan chings brub: ya rkan la/ mi kha dang bra mchu nan chings brub: kha la/ byis pa'i chung sri langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: dpral bar/ rgan pa'i rgan sri langs pa nan chings brub: gdong la/ gzhon sri'i gzhon sri langs pa nan chings brub: mche ba la/ dar ma'i dar sri langs pa nan chings brub: spyi bor/ spyi dgra langs pa thams cad nan chings brub: rna ltag g.yas g.yon du/ phung sri god sri langs pa nan chings brub: ces bris la ring chas cung zad dkris/ bye brag mnan thod dang sa dmigs ni/ dgra 'dre spyi tsam du/ mon pa rabs chad kyi thod par mchod rten gyi zhabs su mnan/ dgra bo spyir spyang ki 'am sha khyi'i thod pa/ yang na 'khor gyi pha mes kyi thod pa/ glang ngam g.yag rwa me chus gang pa skyes pa la g.yas/ bud med la g.yon lam rgya gram dang la btsas/ 'byung po spyi la phag thod mchod rten zhabs/ de yang zhib tu dbye na dgra 'dre gnyis la/ dang po ni bla ma la bya rgod kyi thod pa'am stag gam byi la khrag ris can (218) gyi thod pa mchod rten zhabs/ dge slong la ngang ser mchod rten/ sngags pa la bya rog lha khang*/ lha sngags dam tshig gcig pa'i mched dang slob ma la/ rus sbal gyi khog pa'am sbal nag gi thod par brag gcan gzan 'dra ba'i 'og bon po dang mu stegs la grum pa dang phag nag gcan zan gang rung la btsas/

rgyal po la seṅge'am khyi dkar rgya sgo'i them 'og mi dpon glang thod sbrul nag gam rus sbal 'dra ba'i 'og mi skya phag thod dam glang rwa me chus ma phog par zam 'og bud med wa thod rgya gram lam dur khrod/ byis pa sre mong sgo them 'og mi skya kher 'dong wa thod shing gcig gi drung rnams su bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ dam sri 'phar spyang khyi thod grong gi dbus/ rnal 'byor pa'i dam sri mi khyi ra phag rabs chad kyi thod pa mchod rten 'og 'gong sri sprel thod lha khang them/ rgyal po'i phung sri mon bod hor gsum gyi thod pa chos 'khor gyi dbus sam lha khang*/ blon po'i phung sri spre'u ri bong ne tso'i thod pa pho brang gi mdun/ yul mi'i phung sri mdzo rtol dre'u thod pa sbrul gyi srang ngam yul gyi dbus/ dgra sri rta g.yag gi thod pa dgra rgyud dogs kyi gong gsum mam lam rgya gram lung gsum mdo/ pho sri g.yag rog gi thod par gangs stong sam ri rtse'i la btsas/ mo sri khyi mo nag mo'i thod pa rgyal mtsho'i gting ngam brag gi rtsibs/ dar sri wa dmar gyi thod pa dur gyi 'og chung sri ri'u lu gu khyi gu mig ma bye ba shor skyes dang*/ phe'u gu sre mong thod pa ma yi mal 'og gam lam rgya gram/ rgan sri wa thod chad pa'i zhabs/ dur sri wa thod dur khrod dbus/ dbul sri spyang ki'am ri bong gi thod pa rgya thab kyi 'og phung sri rnga mo'i thod pa grog po phug rdug du/ (219) lceb sri rbab sri phag thod rgya gram lam/ dme sri skya ga'i thod pa khang pa'i zhabs/ gri sri shi ba'i thod pa la btsas 'og rta sri rta thod ri chen zhabs/ god sri 'phar spyang*/ ra lug spre'u/ 'bri rog gam be'u/ yang na god mgo phyi ma ra ba'i dbus/ g.ya' lo'i god sri 'phar ba rnga mo g.ya' yi thod pa 'brog lhas/ ser sri sha ba'i thod pa ser ba 'ong ba'i sgang zur gyi smad/ zhing sri glang rwa'am rdza'i par bu 'ongs ga'i dbus rnams su mnan par bya'o/

gzhan yang mngon spyod kyi yi ge las/ dgra yul mi mthun pa yin na: dgra bo'i yul gru gang zhig gi thod par mnan: dgra bo'i dmag dpon nam dred mong gi thod pa dang: dmag mi'am dom gyi thod par mnan: yul mkhar dang nor rdzas spre'u'i thod par mnan: khyad par gang rung gi dgra dang sri mnan yin na: dgra bo'i che rgyud dang rgan sri rnams dom mgo'i nang du mnan/ dgra bo'i chung rgyud dang mo sri rnams phag mgo'i nang du mnan: gzhon sri dang dbul sri rnams spyang ki'i mgor mnan: chung sri dang the'u rang rnams sre mong mgor: god sri dang nad sri langs pa bya rog gi: mi kha dang kha mchu langs pa rnams wa yi: nad sri dang zhing khang sri rnams bong bu'i:khyim du 'dre chags dang 'gong po'i sri zhugs na ri bong gi: rgyal bsen dang 'byung pos rgyun du za kha zug na khwa ta'i:sun kha dang gshed kha sdang na 'ug pa'i: sgrub la phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa byung na ra'i: pha rol gyi byad zor dang dmod pa rgyun du zug na rkyung ka dang bya rog 'ug pa dur bya rnams kyi mgo bor liṅga bzhag cing mi mgo'i (220) nang du bcug te mnan: zhes dang*/ dgra bo'i dpung tshan che ba yi: dmag dpon sogs la rna ba na: gangs ri spang ri rdza ri la: rtse mo nag por 'dug pa na: mgo chad 'dun phog ri yin la: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: dgra bo dpung tshan chung ba dang: yul mi la sogs dgra yi rigs: mi nag mtshon cha drud 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: phung sri langs na nang 'khrug la: gnam lcags mchod rten brtsegs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: gri sri gzhon sri langs pa na: chos 'byung dgu brtsegs bsnol 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: chung sri bud med sri yin na: btsun mo brang rgyan btags 'dra'i ri: mdun gsham 'og tu dgra bo mnan: sgo nor phyugs kyi sri yin naḥ spre'u dkar bya ra ltas 'dra'i ri:

de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: yul dang zhing gi sri yin na: seṅge gnam du mchong 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnanaḥ kha mchu mi kha'i sri yin na: bya nag sha la rngams 'dra'i ri: de'i 'og tu dgra bo mnan: dam pa chos kyi sri yin na: glegs bam po ti gshibs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnanaḥ chos bsgrub bar gcod sri yin na: bla ma khri khar bzhugs 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: phyogs zas mtho gnon sri yin naḥ rgyal po la thod bsdams 'dra'i ri: de yi 'og tu dgra bo mnan: zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang rnam 'byor pa lta dgongs dang ldan phyin rwa co'i rigs dang*/ ku ba bya sgong sogs rang byung gi snod/ rdza'i ga'u/ la cha'i sgrom bu/ lcags zangs zhwa nye'i par bu/ tsha tsha'i (221) zhabs su rung*/ man ngag snying gzer nag po/ srid pa'i gter khyim/ man ngag rdzong 'phrang*/ rdo rje gtsug lag sogs khog dbubs/ gyim shang mkha' 'gro'i yig chung las/ gtor ma ni/ dong mngar la sprad/ de nas sha khrag gis mchod/ gsungs pa bzhin 'gugs ring dkar mngar gyis sbags pa'i gtor zlum theb skyu can/ las 'grub nas sha khrag gis brgyan pa'i dmar gtor bshams nas*/ gtang rag tu khas blangs te 'jog pa sogs mthong rgyun ltar bya'o// mi bsad gri/ 'brong rnga/ sātstsha nag po/ dur g.yam stong rgya'i ri mo can/ brub khung gi g.yas g.yon du lha dbye'i sgro gnyis 'dzugs/ gzhan yang mnan bsad sogs kyi dus tshod nges pa ni/ khyad par dpyid gsum bdun gsum/ dbyar gsum/ brgyad gsum/ ston gsum/ dgun gsum/ dgun gsum gyi yar ngo'i bcu dang mar ngo'i lnga/ dgu stong rnams la mgon skyabs bral/ gnad 'gag yin min gzhan du ltos/ las 'brel rtsal gyi gshin rje'i las mtha' dgra kha la rgyas 'debs las/ glang gi zla ba'i nya ba'i tho rangs mnan na/ gnam rim pa bcu gsum gyi steng du 'gro/ stong gi nyi ma srod la mnan na/

sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu 'gro/ me thog tu sa 'gro ba de la mnan no/ zhes gsungs/ gzhan yang*/ ji skad du/ bla phur snying phur srog phur gsum// 'di gsum med par las sbyor ba// bya rgod gzan med gshog mi pheb/ zhes dang*/ 'ja' tshon ma ning gi dmar khrid yig chung las/ bla phur srog phur snying phur gsum gyi gnad (222) ma shes na/ sgrub pa don med du 'gro nyen yod/ ces gsungs pas/ bya rgod gyi dang rur bla phur bca'/ de la gzhung gi bla 'gugs kyi sngags dang*/ bla mi ru brdzu na pho nya srin po'i rbad sngags/ u pa ti tsitta nag po u pa ti sa sodaḥ g.yag shar brdzu na stag gzig rbad pa'i sngags/ khaṃ bla tri ta u dant+ri sod/ dgra bo dum bu gtsug ta sri sodaḥ khug ling tsitta nag po sodaḥ a ti tha ti pa ya sodaḥ kha rag yag sodaḥganyan dang bong bu'i pho nya dom dred gnyis/ oṃ ag po rbad su sodaḥ ra dang lug la lcags kyi spyang ki'o/ tsa rag kha rtsa rag khaḥ kha rag rbad dgra bo sodaḥ ma gi dgra snying dum bur sodaḥ sa sha khrag rbad su chodaḥ ces pa'i mthar/ bla sha ri ma ti ghraṃ sha ro ma ti thul thul gug thuṃ rilaḥ zhes sbrel nas bzlas pa dang*/ seng phur sor brgyad pa snying phur du bcas par rbad sngags gong ma'i sham bur/ myog myog ye mugaḥ tsar ling rbadaḥ ces bzla/ gri lcags kyi phur pa srog phur du bcas par mnan/ gzhung gi bsad sngags sham bur/ thabs dar ya thibs srog la rbadaḥ snying mgo chodaḥ kha la za mu long rbadaḥ ces pa rnams rgyas par brgya/ 'bring gang lcogs/ tha ma nyer gcig bzlas nas phur pa so sor btab ste/ gdab pa'i dus/ oṃ badzra kī la kī la yaḥ she tri ku ku la yaṃ shri mā ra ya shri hūm̐ phaṭaḥ ces bla gnas dang bstun nas bla srog 'dzom skabs gdab phur gzugs la yid chags yid la bla 'khor bla srog zung 'brel gyi ru pa la phur pa gdab pas srog 'gags te (223) dbugs chad/ bla bsad pas rnam shes kyi rten med par gsungs so/

liṅga lteb pa'i gnad ni/ dgra 'dre gnyis las dang po ni/ ji skad du/ liṅga ltag pa bcag ste snying ga'i nṛ la kha sbyar/ 'phongs nas yar lteb ste mtshan ma ltag pa la kha sbyar/ dai nas g.yas lteb dang g.yon lteb lan gsum byas la/ zhes dang*/ bla ma dgongs 'dus kyi srung bzlog bsad pa'i gab yig byad ma stobs 'joms las/ lteb tshul gong dang 'dra bar gsungs ba'i rjes/ rim gyis lteb la gru gsum du 'byung ba dang*/ rtse mthur du phyogs par/ yug sa'i dor rtas dril/ de ro ras kyis dril ba sogs gsungs/ tsakra'i yig 'bru rnams ye shes lha'i ngo bor gyur pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ dmod bcol sngags sgra dang bcas pas zlog byed kyi las byed par bsam/ zhes dang*/ lnga pa chen pos liṅga'i yi ger byugs rdzas la dbyer med 'byed mdzad pa'i dgongs pa mthun/ de la shin lteb tu 'bod/ ro lteb tu byed na/ kha rkub sprad/ 'dre lteb la snying ga'i sa bon bcag bgegs rigs la ring ba nyid shas che bar gsungs/ de rjes pho la dpung pa g.yas dang mo la g.yon la bcog mgo nas mar dril ba dang*/ mjug nas yar lteb tsam byed pa'i lugs gnyis snang ba snga ma las phyi ma 'thad par bsam/ rus lteb ni dkyil 'khor gzhung bcag ste zur gnyis lteb pas kha sbyar zur gsum du yod/ lcags lteb nar mo dril/ mtshon lteb bam ro sgong du grags pa gong du bshad/ gzhung gzhan las/ g.yas kyis g.yon (224) bkab/ mgo nas mar dril gsungs pa gang ltar byed kyang yugs sa ma skyes pa gzhan dang 'khrig pa spyad cing yun ring ma song ba'i skra shad dang*/ ban bon gyi lag nas byung pa'i tshon skud sngon dmar ram/ sna lnga spro na ser po la/ badzra ti ri bi ri rbudaḥ dmar po la/ kha la rakṣa rbadaḥ sngon por/ dan ti rbad su rbadaḥ dkar po la/ lo shig kha du 'byung ba trig na nanaḥ nag po la/ zla sri sri sha sod hūm̐ḥ zhes brgya brgya re btab pa sde brgyad kyi byad thag tu bsam la dkris/

mnan chas gzhung bzhin bya'o/ lto 'phye brtag pa ni/ bam brgyad kyi 'grel par/ lto 'phye gnas pa'i mtshan nyid ni// ston zla gsum gyi zla ba la// nyi ma 'gro ba'i rim pa bzhin// mgo shar kha lho g.yon gyis nyal// dgun zla gsum gyi zla ba la// nub tu kha bltas mgo bo lho/ dpyid zla gsum gyi zla ba la// byang du kha bltas nub tu mgo dbyar zla gsum gyi zla ba la// shar du kha bltas byang du mgo /sa bdag lto 'phye de ltar gnas// skyes bu chen pos lto 'phye brko/ zhes pa ltar la/ tshes zhag sum brgya drug cu'i re'u mig la longs spyod pa'i thig ma nor bar btab cing lto ba'i thad nas brko'o/ de la mnan pa'i dong tshad ni/ gter khyim las/ khru gang yan chad sa ro yin/ phan gnod med do/ de nas sor dgu ma mo'i gnas yin 'gong chog mnan/ de nas sor bcu brtan ma'i gnas yin pas dgra bgegs mnan/ de nas sor nyi shu rtsa bzhi klu'i gnas yin pas mnan na (225) dgra phung ngo*/ zhes dang*/ zur gsum thod pa shong ba 'dru// de bas chung na rtsub ste rang la ldog /de bas thung na 'jam pas dgra mi 'chi'o/ zhes dang*/ rdo rje gtsug lag gi gong du bshad pa dang mthun pa'i brtan ma'i gnas de la mnan pa thams cad shis par gsuungs pas de tsam rgyas bsdus 'tshams/ las grub nas ngag tu/ oṃ ya mānta ka ya ma ka ka dgra bgegs sarba trig nan rbad nan: bhi na tsatta rbad nan lam nan nan: zhes brgya stong bzlas pas phyir mi lta/ khrom dang mi mang gi gseb tu 'khyams pa dang rtsal rtsol 'brel med lab pa/ ming bsgyur ba sogs kyang byas pas rang la mi ldog gzhan yang gshed 'bebs kyi skor gnam skas gter ma sogs la 'dris par yang bya'o/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ nam yang 'gyur ba med pa'i lhun po ches// bdud bgegs ldang du med par mnan nas kyang*// sgrib gnyis dri ma med pa'i dpal chen po// yid can lhag ma med pas mngon gyur shog

/zhais kun mkhyen chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i rdo rje'i gsung dang dpe ris sogs zhal 'phang rnams spyi 'gros brgyan te dpal chen 'dus pas bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel// ༈ rdo rje gtsug lag gi le'u nyer dgu pa las/ de nas kun la gces pa'i bcud/ rang la mi bzlog phar thebs pa'i gzer bzhi btab pa de'i dang po/ phar la mi thebs mi srid bcud pa'i gzer/ 'khor lo phung shig sdong ldad ces bya pa/ liṅga dril la mgo mjug ldog ste rang thag kyu mig la yar nas mar la lan bdun dag tu (226) 'don par bya/ de'i tshe/ dgra bo che ge mo rbad rbud nṛ rbad rbud ya: sngags de brgya stong bzlas pas phye mar song bar bsam/ de nas gnyis pa 'gyangs mi srid pa ni/ liṅga dril ba phyi la mar sgo'i them 'og tu lan bdun nang nas phyir drang ngo*/ de'i tshe/ dgra bo che ge mo srog nṛ lam nan mā ra ya rbad nan: zhes bzla'o/ gsum pa rang la bzlog mi srid pa ni/ gtad pa'i las gang yang byed dus su 'khor lo la/ rang nyid bskor ba phyir log lan bdun bya/ de'i tshe/ badzra sarba duṣṭhāṃ bhyoḥche ge mo sha truṃ rbad rbud sod nan: ces brjod slar yang rang gi rkang pa la phyi bskor lan gsum skor te mnan/ bzhi pa mnan nas mi ldang bar bya ba ni/ steng du ro g.yam rdo rje rgya gram dang*/ lam̐ la ri rab bskyed/ de nas nam du'ang mi thar bar bsam/
badzra sarba duṣṭhaṃ e bhyo: dgra bgegs sarba trig nanaḥrbad nan: bhi na tsitta rbad nan: lam̐ nan nan: ces brgya rtsa'am stong du brjod/ ces so/// /
